text:
If you’re heading out for sunset, you’ll get a clear one tonight, with the sun setting at 5:59 and the temperature still near the upper 50s. Skies stay mostly clear after dark, but the chill settles in quickly, with a low around 35 and a light north wind. A jacket will earn its keep by evening.

Wednesday starts with a little patchy fog before 8, then turns sunny and cooler, topping out near 54. Winds will be light, and there’s no rain in the forecast. High pressure keeps the dry stretch going, so tomorrow’s best plan is simple: allow a little extra care for the foggy start, then enjoy the sunshine through the afternoon.
